d: Bihar ki rajdhani patna ke patna siti ilake men ganga nadi ke kinare prashasan ka bara atikraman hatao abhiyan chal raha hai. suprim kort ke aadesh ke anupalan men bhari pulis bal ki tainati ke bich kaee avaidh eent-bhatthon aur nirmanon ko buldojar se dhvast kiya ja raha hai. is karravaee par patna purvi ki SP shailja ne bataya ki suprim kort ke nirdeshon ke tahat yah abhiyan chalaya ja raha hai aur kanun-vyavastha banae rakhne ke lie mauke par paryapt pulis bal ki tainati ke sath sabhi jaruri ehtiyati kadam uthae ja rahe hain.
